## Website Purpose

This portfolio showcases Jaimin's engineering projects, technical blog articles, skills, and professional services. It serves as a primary point of contact for freelance collaborations, contract engineering work, technical consulting, and open-source contributions. The site is built on a custom React + Firebase stack with a full admin CMS, live dynamic data fetching, and premium Framer Motion animations.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://jaiminumaraniya.me/): Main portfolio landing page with dynamic hero section, skills, featured project, testimonials, and FAQ — all data-driven from Firebase
- [Projects](https://jaiminumaraniya.me/projects): Award-quality projects page with alternating magazine-style layouts (Featured Showcase, Split Focus, Bisection Grid, Storyteller, Archive), sticky filter bar, and cursor spotlight microinteractions
- [Blog](https://jaiminumaraniya.me/blog): Technical articles with a reader-experience-first design — floating frosted-glass reading bar, scroll progress indicator, dynamic font sizing (A-/A+), and related posts
- [About](https://jaiminumaraniya.me/about): Professional background, philosophy, and biography
- [Contact](https://jaiminumaraniya.me/contact): Hire or reach out to Jaimin for work
- [Project Detail](https://jaiminumaraniya.me/projects/:id): Individual case study pages with cinematic image ratios, reading progress bar, text sizer, floating CTA bar, and rich markdown rendering
- [Blog Detail](https://jaiminumaraniya.me/blog/:id): Individual article reader pages with floating controls, code block copy buttons, responsive tables, GSAP entrance animations, and engagement tracking

## Core Skills & Technologies

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, GSAP, Vite
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage, Functions), REST APIs
- Databases: Firestore (NoSQL), PostgreSQL, Supabase
- AI/ML: Google Gemini API, Google Generative AI SDK, OpenRouter, LLM integrations
- DevOps: Netlify, Vercel, Firebase Hosting, GitHub Actions, CI/CD
- CMS: Custom Firebase CMS (blog + project management with admin panel)
- UI Libraries: shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Lucide Icons, Progressive Image lazy loading
- Design System: Custom 8px grid spacing, design tokens, glassmorphism, noise textures, SVG microinteractions

## Site Architecture & Notable Technical Details

- **Admin Panel**: Full CMS at `/admin` for managing projects, blogs, settings, and media
- **Image Handling**: Custom `ProgressiveImage` component with blur-up reveal and natural aspect ratios
- **SEO**: Full JSON-LD structured data (Person, WebSite, Blog, Project schemas), Open Graph, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt/llms-full.txt, canonical URLs
- **Performance**: Lazy image loading, React Query caching, code splitting, transforms-only animations to prevent CLS
- **Engagement Tracking**: Real-time likes and view counters per blog/project stored in Firestore
- **Accessibility**: WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigation, focus states, semantic HTML, reduced-motion respect
